messages.subject: For Alex Vaughan | Infrastructure, government relations and stakeholder execution
messages.body:
Dear Costain Investor Relations Team,

Please place this executive introduction before Mr. Alex Vaughan, Chief Executive Officer.

Costain's growing role across transport, energy, water and critical national infrastructure requires disciplined alignment across government, customers, communities and delivery teams. That interface closely matches the work I lead today.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My responsibilities span government and regulatory relations, ESG, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory. I lead senior institutional engagement and coordinate complex cross-functional stakeholder matters across regulated operations.

I would welcome a senior conversation about where this combination of government relations, sustainability and infrastructure stakeholder strategy might support Costain's priorities. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to Costain.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com
